messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 32):
"""
S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) Minimum Maximum Minimum Maximum Details of sub limits imposed in the following format (furnish separately for each option or plan of the group insurance product) Name of Option or Plan: Type of Benefit for which sub limit is imposed Sub Limit in absolute terms (in INR) Sub Limit as a percentage Minimum Maximum Minimum Maximum 2.4 Sum Insured offered Minimum(Rs.) Maximum (Rs.) 2.5 Whether any Add ons offered Yes / No 2.6 If yes, Number of Add ons offered Details of Add ons Offered Nam e of Add on Sum Assured Deductible Co-Pay Sub Limit Min Max Min Max Min Max Min Max 2.7 Number of Options or plans Offered Details of Options Offered Name Sum Assured Deductible Co-Pay Sub Limit Min Max Min Max Min Max Min Max 2.8 Minimum membership of the Group 2.9 Target Group Employer-Employee Non-Employer-Employee Social Sector Others (Please specify) 2.10 Expected ICR 2.11 Whether a Board approved underwriting policy is in place with respect to this Group Health Insurance Product?
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the minimum and maximum sum insured that an insurer must offer for a group health insurance plan under the IRDAI Master Circular?","answer":"The insurer must offer a minimum sum insured of Rs. 2.4 and a maximum sum insured of Rs. 2.5.","facts":["2.4 Sum Insured offered Minimum(Rs.)","Maximum (Rs.)"]},{"question":"If an insurer offers add‑ons for a group health insurance product, what information must they provide about each add‑on?","answer":"They must provide the name of the add‑on, its sum assured, deductible, co‑pay, and sub‑limit details, including minimum and maximum values for each.","facts":["2.6 If yes, Number of Add ons offered","Details of Add ons Offered Nam e of Add on Sum Assured Deductible Co-Pay Sub Limit Min Max"]}]}
